clauses.reason: EO 13316 section 3 orders that the listed orders, which established committees that "have terminated or whose work is completed", "are revoked:" and item (b) lists "Executive Order 12975, as amended by Executive Orders 13018, 13046," and 13137, establishing the National Bioethics Advisory Commission. That names this order. Section 6 states "This order shall be effective September 30, 2003.", so the first end is 2003-09-30. The one-sentence amendment of section 3(a) of EO 12975 continued, amended by EO 13137 (a later event), until the parent was revoked.

research_rationale:
EO 13018 (signed 1996-09-16; 61 FR 49045, Federal Register of 1996-09-18, FR Doc. 96-24048) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13018.txt. It consists of one sentence that, to add three members to the National Bioethics Advisory Commission, deletes the number 15 and inserts 18 in the second sentence of section 3(a) of EO 12975. First end: EO 13316 (signed 2003-09-17; 68 FR 55255, Federal Register of 2003-09-23), section 3(b), revokes "Executive Order 12975, as amended by Executive Orders 13018, 13046," and 13137, establishing the Commission, among orders that established committees that "have terminated or whose work is completed"; section 6 states "This order shall be effective September 30, 2003." EO 13316 names this order, so the revocation is an express revocation reaching it. Later events: EO 13137 (signed 1999-09-15) restated section 3 of EO 12975 and added a new section 4 with a membership limit; under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling that amendment is a later event and the clause continues until the parent ends. The parent's own termination provision, as later restated, is an earlier candidate: no held source shows an extension past the restated date or the date the Commission actually ceased, and under the owner's 2026-10-21 reasoning for orders whose bodies finish their work (the order stays on the books until revoked) it is a spent fact, not the end. The held text is the machine-extracted text layer of the official Federal Register PDF; the PDF page images are not held, so identity (printed number, title, signing date and FR Doc. number) was checked on the text layer against the census register row.

savings.reason: EO 13316 has no savings or exception wording for this order in the quoted section 3 or section 6. The amended membership number was a composition rule for a Commission that has no continuing existence after the revocation; no appointment, fund or right created by this order is held.
